protocol_audit.reason: The official evaluation mode loads target video frames and uses DUSt3R-estimated target poses; this violates the frozen target-image leakage boundary.
protocol_audit.reason_2: The public CLI exposes spherical d_phi/d_theta/d_r/pan controls around a center-depth origin rather than a calibrated arbitrary source/target 4x4 pair.
protocol_audit.qualified_adapter: Unproject frozen source RGB plus RGB-only BaseDepth with the calibrated source intrinsics, interpolate the true source-to-target camera trajectory into 25 explicit PyTorch3D cameras, feed only the rendered RGB video to the frozen diffusion model, and evaluate only the final target frame.

gates: all rendered and generated frames finite
no target truth enters renderer or diffusion

stop_boundary: Do not run all 14 val targets unless the one-target adapter, finite-output and 16 GiB gates pass. A smoke pass still does not establish RGB quality.
